server_hostname.description: Publicly visible hostname for the server (e.g., in server browser).

admin_email.description: Admin contact email for server inquiries or issues.

basedir.description: Base directory where Quake game files (wads, models, etc.) are located.

start_map.description: First map to load when the server starts (must exist in maps/ or basedir).

port.description: TCP/UDP port the server listens on for QuakeWorld clients.

maxclients.description: Maximum number of player slots (including reserved).

deathmatch.description: Deathmatch mode (0 = coop, 1 = deathmatch, 2 = teamplay, 3 = arena).

fraglimit.description: Match ends when a player or team reaches this frag count (0 = disabled).

timelimit.description: Match ends after this many minutes (0 = disabled).

map_list.description: List of maps to cycle through in rotation.

items.description: Name of a Quake map (e.g., 'start', 'e1m1', 'e2m2') — must exist in basedir/maps/ or server data dir.

reserved_slots.description: Number of slots reserved for admins or privileged players.

sv_maxrate.description: Maximum bytes/sec clients may download from server (0 = unlimited).

sv_minrate.description: Minimum bytes/sec clients must receive (helps throttling).

sv_maxupdaterate.description: Maximum updates per second the server sends to clients.

sv_minupdaterate.description: Minimum updates per second the server sends to clients.

allow_download.description: Whether clients may download map/models from this server (required for custom content).

allow_upload.description: Whether clients may upload files to the server (rarely needed, security risk).

sv_cheats.description: Enable development cheats (e.g., noclip, god). Should be false for public servers.

gravity.description: Server-side gravity value (Quake units per second²). Standard is ~800.

allow_unsecure_commands.description: Allow unencrypted remote commands (e.g., via rcon) — disable unless needed.

logfile.description: Path to server log file. Set to empty string to disable logging.

motd_file.description: Path to a text file containing the MOTD (Message of the Day). Overrides motd_lines if present.

motd_lines.description: Lines of text to show as the MOTD on client connect.

extra_startup_commands.description: Additional mvdsv-specific or plugin commands to run at startup (e.g., exec plugins.cfg).

items.description: A single console command line (e.g., 'exec plugins.cfg').

sv_voicequality.description: Voice chat quality (0–5; higher = better quality, more bandwidth).
